main_text.l: ac mirentur; Cæteros autem, quos sæpe non latet quidem ars eorum, sed pudet artis eorum, despiciant, velut aridos, siccos, exsangues, & Minervæ (crassæ scilicet illius) turpe repudium. Faštum desidia sequitur: cur enim studeant, qui sibi satis superque docti sunt? cur anxiè quærant, quod consecutos se credunt? quo scandant, quos jam in culmen evexit sua persua-sio? Lexica modò sint ad manum, Indices, Analecta, Polyantheæ, Theatra Mundi, & similes ad omnem pedem facti cothurni: his freti, securè stertunt, & dormiunt, quod dici solet, in utramq; aurem. Quin etiam farragines illas (ita frontem perfricuêre) subinde non verentur palam hoc Titulo notare venditare, Dormi securè: Erubescit ad hoc probrum, Diligentiæ præses Aurora, ejulant antelucana galli-

page.notes: Right page margin text is cut off by the scan edge and is not legible; omitted. The hyphenated word "galli-" continues on the next page. Some letters in the left text are uncertain (e.g. "Faštum" should read "Fastum"; the "š" is a scan artefact, copied as printed: Faštum is an error for Fastum; "Polyantheæ" contains a possibly Cyrillic-looking letter and should be read as Polyanthææ with Latin e).
